summary: Iteration 61: Tested NEW cancellation UIs + reasons manager (Customer MyTrips, Operator /operator/cancel-bookings, Admin CancellationReasonsManager) plus backend regression via existing test_iter60_refund_approval.py. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass (fixed one pre-existing test-data bug where operator_id was not linked). Frontend: all three role flows work end-to-end: customer cancels a booking (10% policy deduction toast, status becomes 'Cancellation Requested'), operator cancels a booking (25→24, mandatory reason enforced, disabled confirm until reason selected), admin adds+deletes a customer reason. Refund Approvals staff page correctly lists new CUSTOMER CANCEL (₹1,03,500 refundable after 10% deduction) and OPERATOR CANCEL (₹1,15,000 full refund) requests as pending — regression clean.

issues: Radix DialogContent warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}' — a11y nit, add DialogDescription to both cancel dialogs.

Console spam: 'Refused to set unsafe header "Accept-Encoding"'. Some axios instance is trying to set Accept-Encoding manually; browsers block it. Remove that header from the request interceptor to clean up console.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Remove hardcoded 'Accept-Encoding' header from axios (services/api.js or wherever REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL client is created) — browser rejects it and it floods the console.
(Optional a11y) Add <DialogDescription> to Customer cancel dialog (MyTrips.js) and Operator cancel dialog (OperatorCancelBookings.js) to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: refund_approval_routes.py list_reasons() seeds defaults inside a GET handler with no locking — under concurrent first-time requests, duplicate seed rows are possible. Consider a startup seed or an atomic upsert per (audience, label).

operator_cancellable_bookings() returns bookings + inquiries but does not exclude already-cancellation_requested / refund-pending items on the client if a race occurs; UI relies on backend filtering — status list already covers this so OK, just verify statuses stay in sync when refund is rejected (re-open cancellability?).
